cohort: 775 patients who underwent programmed or natural FET cycles resulting in a singleton live birth using blastocysts vitrified between 2013 and 2018
finding: Programmed FET cycles were associated with a two-fold higher probability of HDP compared to natural FET cycles.
mod_finding: Programmed FET resulted in a higher probability of caesarean delivery compared with natural FET (53.2% [206/387] versus 42.8% [163/381]; P = 0.03).
birth_weight: Programmed FET: 3357.9 ± 671.6 g, Natural FET: 3318.4 ± 616.2 g (P = 0.40)
